title: Gestalt Evaluation
summary: Gestalt evaluation checks whether perceived grouping and continuity communicate intended information architecture; principles and definitions live in VIS-008.

MUST.text: Compare perceived groups with semantic relationships and interaction boundaries.

SHOULD.text: Apply VIS-008 principles (proximity, similarity, continuity, common region) deliberately; cite VIS-008 for definitions.

AVOID.text: Do not group unrelated controls just because they share a card.

DECIDE.decision: Add boundary or spacing per VIS-008
Group by task, not layout convenience

EXAMPLE.good: Label, input and error form one perceived group
EXAMPLE.bad: Card groups submit button with unrelated settings

FAILURE_MODES: Visual grouping can imply false hierarchy; verify with task scanning.
Consistent styling across different behaviors causes misclicks; differentiate roles.
Responsive reflow can break grouping; re-check at narrow widths.
